reports.title: DEUTSCHE BANK'S EPSTEIN SCANDAL! Shares Slide 6% After Explosive Expose Revealed Secret Transitions
reports.description:
Deutsche Bank shares slid more than 6% in early Frankfurt trading following revelations from a massive leak of 15 million internal files showing the lender processed $582 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein. The investigation, conducted by a global consortium of over 200 journalists, found that the flagged volume is more than double the amount previously identified by U.S. Senate investigators.
